evaluation_rounds.reason: The first research panel measured checkpoint-100352 at 195/200 successes and checkpoint-120832 at 194/200, but that panel informed the apparent selection of the former and therefore is not independent confirmation. Both remain below the 196/200 objective on researcher-owned evidence, while the fixed task-reference panel is permanently reused and cannot resolve independence. A paired measurement on episodes 2200-2399 tests whether the small late-checkpoint difference generalizes before closure.
